title: Dev's Medieval
description: A modpack made by Devilshork based around adventure and exploration
body: Dev's medieval is largely based on exploration. It's filled with explorable structures, challenging dungeons, and a completely revamped method of getting to the end. I attempted to keep the ability to become overpowered to a minimum meanin there will always be a challenge and you won't be able to just walk around curb stombing every mob you come across.
